name: LUKE arm
def: Advanced prosthetic arm developed by DEKA under the DARPA Revolutionizing Prosthetics programme, able to make several grips and move the shoulder, elbow and wrist together.
facts: Cleared for marketing by the US Food and Drug Administration in May 2014
Nicknamed after Luke Skywalker's bionic hand
